title: Among cards illustrated by 'Erica Yang' that are legal in the 'pauper' form
question: Among cards illustrated by 'Erica Yang' that are legal in the 'pauper' format, find the one with the oldest original release date and list all of its legal play formats.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T2."XCL_084"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'Erica Yang'
  AND T1."XCL_072" = (
      SELECT T1b."XCL_072"
      FROM cards AS T1b
      INNER JOIN legalities AS T2b ON T1b."XCL_072" = T2b."XCL_086"
      WHERE T1b."XCL_002" = 'Erica Yang'
        AND T2b."XCL_084" = 'pauper'
        AND T2b."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
      ORDER BY T1b."XCL_019" ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
